workload.source_decode: Software FFV1 decode; this FFmpeg build has no Vulkan hwaccel for FFV1
workload.viewer: Half resolution, native effects and OCIO, H.264 NVENC cache, one-frame chunks, two pending encode frames
workload.graph: source + editable constant-color overlay -> merge -> output; second constant-color/output branch added through commands
workload.scrub_frames: 1..39 with parameter edits; explicit visits to 40, 41, 47 and 90

native_interaction_observations.heartbeat_scope: Whole native interaction run including startup, edits, source replacement, resize, zoom, workspace reset and waits; not edit-to-visible latency
native_interaction_observations.visual_confirmation: Native window capture inspected; viewer, graph parameter controls, output selector, shared playhead and timeline current/outdated state visible. Graph toolbar scrolls when narrower than its controls.

review_correction_run.renderer: Culled C++ GraphItem and TimelineItem; viewport pan and native timeline pointer input exercised
review_correction_run.heartbeat_scope: Whole scenario including a burst adding 36 unused nodes, source probing, resize and workspace changes; not single-edit or edit-to-visible latency
review_correction_run.range_error: Cache frame 1000: node 'source' (id 1, type 'source'): frame 1000 is past the end of source 'src'; the stream is exhausted at frame 95
regressions: SharedCacheIdentitySurvivesPublicationFromTwoDestinations failed before identity deduplication and passed after the fix, including reopen from disk.
CacheRangeReportsAsynchronousDiskAdmissionFailure observes rejected persistence through runtime cache error/drop counters, with zero stored frames.
InteractiveGraphAndTimelineUseCommandsAndSharePlayhead exercises native timeline drag and on-screen slip controls.

thread_sanitizer_scheduler_exercise.scope: Current ViewerScheduler.cpp, Document.cpp and Graph.cpp compiled together with -fsanitize=thread; setarch x86_64 -R avoids this host's default unexpected-memory-mapping startup failure. No race suppression.

packaged_application.scope: Three cold/live startup requests; window-system handoff, not physical scanout. Not evidence for the <=100 ms p95 benchmark target in issue #16.

sanitizer_limitations.native_sanitized_nvenc_scenario: Did not pass: cuInit reported CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY and the subsequent cached-return assertion failed
sanitizer_limitations.independent_cuda_reproduction: An ASan/UBSan executable containing only dlopen(libcuda.so.1), cuInit(0), printf and dlclose returned CUDA result 2 without Nemo or Qt
sanitizer_limitations.independent_qt_reproduction: An ASan/UBSan QGuiApplication with a zero-delay quit, no Nemo, no window and no Vulkan reproduced 1152 bytes of QtWayland registry-proxy leaks
sanitizer_limitations.policy: No new sanitizer suppression or disabled leak checking was added. Native non-sanitized interaction evidence and targeted sanitizer regression results are reported separately.

scope_limits: The timeline exposes persisted source slip/retime and shared scrubbing, not absent clip-occurrence move/trim semantics.
Native Windows interaction was not exercised.
This is not the integrated issue #16 latency benchmark or proof of its target.
